notablePrerequisites:
Godsire does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating an 8/8 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Xenograft, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Godsire.
Repeat.
